title: Node.js runtime vs browser engine
description: Identify runtime capabilities, inspect Node version and modules, and create a diagnostic script that avoids assuming browser globals exist.
objectives: Distinguish JavaScript language features from host APIs
Inspect Node version, platform and runtime capabilities
Explain ES modules and CommonJS in existing projects
Write a capability probe that works with explicit inputs
rubric: I inspected my actual Node version and executable path.
I compared ESM, CommonJS and browser-only APIs.
I implemented and tested the runtime capability probe.
